title: Local Frobenius transport for an equivariant power translate at supplied geometric lifts
statement: Let $k_1/k_0$, $X,C,c,\theta,r$ be a cartesian finite-field constant extension with $\#k_1=(\#k_0)^r$ [def-pc-base-change, def-zl-source-constant-field-restriction]. Let $P,Q$ be $F_r$-algebras with invertible return and let $e:F_jP\simeq Q$ satisfy $F_r(e)\,;\phi_Q=c_{j,r}(P)\,;F_j(\phi_P)\,;e$, where $c$ is the coherent iterated-pullback commutor [lem-zl-frobenius-power-return-commutation]. Let $A,B$ be constructible source Weil sheaves on $C$ whose underlying Weil objects equal the transports of $P,Q$ through $\theta$. Supply any geometric point $s$ of $\bar C$, a natural $m$, and fixed-point squares $s\,;\operatorname{Fr}_C^m=\sigma_1^m\,;s$ and $T_j(s)\,;\operatorname{Fr}_C^m=\sigma_1^m\,;T_j(s)$, with $T_j$ the actual composite defined in [lem-zl-frobenius-power-deck-points]. Then the source Frobenius modules $B_s^{(m)}$ and $A_{T_j(s)}^{(m)}$ [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] are equivalent. There are no finite points, ambient sheaf, monomorphisms, or point-existence conclusions in this assertion.

proof.text: Construct beta=theta^{-1} Fr_X^j theta and the carrier isomorphism alpha: beta^* A -> B explicitly using inverse-automorphism pushforward, pushforward composition and theta_* e. Its definition contains no unproved data. Use the single-return comparison to obtain its compatibility with the Weil structures. Conjugating theta ; Fr_C = Fr_X^r ; theta and commuting powers proves beta commutes with Fr_C.

For positive m, prove that the maps on global sections induced by alpha intertwine transports along the m-fold returns, by induction on m. The base case is globalSectionsTransport_comm_of_upperStar after frobeniusPowStr_one. In the successor step factor a transport of length m+1 into transports of lengths m and 1 through the point t ; Fr_C^{-m}. Commutation of beta with powers of Fr_C gives the two required squares. Apply the induction hypothesis and the single-return identity, then recompose with globalSectionsTransport_frobeniusPowStr_comp.

At s, the alpha-induced map T from the stalk of A at s ; beta to the stalk of B at s is invertible: globalSectionsTransport_eq_of_iso expresses it using pullback-composition isomorphisms, pullback of alpha and the identity scalar isomorphism. The actual composite s ; beta equals frobeniusPowerTranslatePoint. For m>0 apply the transport identity to the two supplied squares with the same scalar sigma_1^m; frobeniusEnd_stalkAt identifies these transports with the local Frobenii. For m=0 both Frobenii are identities. Apply FrobeniusModule.Equiv.ofComp to the linear equivalence of T and invert it to get the required B-to-A equivalence.

theorem nonempty_stalk_equiv_of_equivariant_power_translate
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {k₁ : Type u} [Field k₁] [Finite k₁] [Algebra k₀ k₁]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k₀ k₁] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} [C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))] {c : C ⟶ X}
    (hc : IsPullback c (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁))))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (P Q : IsoAlgebra (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X r))
    (j : ℕ)
    (e : (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X j).obj P.carrier ≅ Q.carrier)
    (he : (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X r).map e.hom ≫ Q.str.hom =
      (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowerCommIso j r).hom.app P.carrier ≫
        (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X j).map P.str.hom ≫ e.hom)
    (A B : WeilSheaf k₁ l C)
    (hA : A.obj = (IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.transportCommIso
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso hc) r
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_geometricGaloisFrobenius
        hc r hr))).obj P)
    (hB : B.obj = (IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.transportCommIso
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso hc) r
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_geometricGaloisFrobenius
        hc r hr))).obj Q)
    (s : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure k₁)) ⟶ (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber)
    (m : ℕ)
    (hs : s ≫ ((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).hom =
      (specGeometricFrobenius k₁ ^ m).hom ≫ s)
    (hs' : Scheme.Hom.frobeniusPowerTranslatePoint hc j s ≫
        ((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).hom =
      (specGeometricFrobenius k₁ ^ m).hom ≫
        Scheme.Hom.frobeniusPowerTranslatePoint hc j s) :
    Nonempty ((B.stalkAt s m hs).Equiv
      (A.stalkAt (Scheme.Hom.frobeniusPowerTranslatePoint hc j s) m hs'))
